text: Any teachers in the house?
Bitch. Look, basically, your main job, your main job, all you
do all day is show my kid what to do at home.
Like, well, here's an example. Go through it
at home.
Here's a sentence. Well, go through it
at home.
And this poem, this one right here, this poem,
you'll learn this poem at home with your dad.
With my dad? Teach it at school! School teaches, not home. There's a song:
remember?
"They teach at school, at school." Subtract, multiply, damn it! School! There's no
"They teach at home" song!
At home they teach you chores. Wipe your own ass, always flush. That's what home teaches.
So basically, all you do is, all day long,
hand us the homework. It's the same as
my car going up on the lift:
"Uh-huh, you need new control arms,
new springs, replace it all.
Now drive off and fix it
with your dad, then come back and show us."
That's how they taught us at school. And we turned out fine.
